segments.source: This section is a list of guidelines for working with LLMs, as well as a summary of the moderation policy.
segments.translation: 이 절은 LLM과 함께 작업하기 위한 지침 목록이며, 검토 정책(moderation policy)의 요약이기도 합니다.

segments.source: This is not the policy itself; see [Forge][LLM policy].
segments.translation: 이것이 정책 자체는 아니며, [Forge][LLM policy]를 참고하십시오.

segments.source: If the two conflict, Forge is canonical.
segments.translation: 둘이 상충할 경우, Forge가 기준이 됩니다.

segments.source: If you are writing code using an LLM, see [Writing LLM-created code](llm-guidance/writing.md).
segments.translation: LLM을 사용하여 코드를 작성하는 경우, [Writing LLM-created code](llm-guidance/writing.md)를 참고하십시오.

segments.source: If you are reviewing LLM-created code, or reviewing using an LLM, see [Reviewing with LLMs](llm-guidance/reviewing.md).
segments.translation: LLM이 작성한 코드를 검토하거나 LLM을 사용하여 검토하는 경우, [Reviewing with LLMs](llm-guidance/reviewing.md)를 참고하십시오.
